name: Co-termination proration to existing contract end-date (add aligns to anchor term-end)
expected: A co-term add prorates the new line from its StartDate to the EXISTING contract/asset end-date (anchor), computing a FRACTIONAL PricingTermCount to the anchor (PTC = (anchorEnd - start)/fullTerm, ~5/12 for a contract ending in 5mo of a 12mo term) rather than a fresh full term=1; net prorated to the shared end-date; EndDate = anchor end; renewal then co-terms all lines together to one shared end-date.
actual: V21 Proration step (skeleton steps 121 Term-Defined proration filter -> 122 List Operation -> 123 Proration; SellingModelType='TermDefined') derives PricingTermCount = (EndDate - StartDate, inclusive)/365 from the line's actual (anchor) effective dates. Proven on REAL existing co-term lines + a fresh Force-reprice. Control 0QLWC000002SYdV4AW (TermDefined 'Term Based - Annual', SubTerm=1, Start 2026-04-15, anchor EndDate 2027-03-31, USD, list 250): Force-reprice of Quote 0Q0WC000002DWNV0A4 via REST place (pricingPref=Force) isSuccess=true/errorResponse=[], LastModified bumped to 2026-06-30T02:00:35Z, DETERMINISTICALLY re-derived PricingTermCount=0.9616438356164384 = EXACTLY 351/365 (350-day window + 1 inclusive) - i.e. the fraction to the anchor end, NOT a full term=1. Org has 22 fractional-PTC QLIs whose PTC equals their date-window fraction (e.g. 0QLWC000002dNlB4AU PTC=0.5671 = 207/365 for 2026-03-08->2026-09-30 ~6.8mo; 0QLWC000002LCwH4AW PTC=0.7397 for 2026-04-06->2026-12-31; Amendment-type line 0QLWC000003ZQab4AG PTC=0.989). Co-term-ALL-lines-together proven on Order 801WC00000hJfDUYA0: 8 OrderItems all sharing the SAME anchor end-date 2026-09-01 with the SAME PTC=0.8328767123287671 = EXACTLY 304/365 - the fractional anchor proration carries to the order tier and co-terms every line to the one shared end-date. The catalog's '~5/12' is a month-approximation of this day-precise fraction (5mo ~ 152/365 ~ 0.416 ~ 5/12=0.4167); mechanism matches.

MECHANISM (full trace, not statically reasoned alone - confirmed by live reprice + 22 real fractional-PTC lines): V21 has TWO proration paths feeding ProrationMultiplier->PricingTermCount. (1) TermDefined path (skeleton 121-123, gate SellingModelType='TermDefined'): Proration with EffectiveTo<-EffectiveTo (the line's contract-pricing effective dates). When the line's EndDate is the anchor co-term end-date (shorter than start+full-term), the engine returns a FRACTIONAL multiplier = (anchorEnd-start, inclusive)/365 -> this IS the anchor-end proration the scenario tests, and it is what fires for the SubscriptionTerm=12 TermDefined co-term add in test_setup. (2) Evergreen path (Proration64, gate SellingModelType='Evergreen' AND AllowPartialProrationPeriods=true AND itemTransientEndDate IsNotNull): EffectiveTo<-itemTransientEndDate, the explicit transient/anchor end-date for evergreen anytime proration. The co-term ANCHOR DATE RESOLUTION (setting the line EndDate / TransientEndDate to the existing contract end) is done by the platform RLM amend/co-term engine BEFORE pricing and fed to V21 via context (EffectiveTo / itemTransientEndDate are input/inputoutput context tags, never written by a proc step - 21 input param blocks, 0 outputs); V21 then computes the fraction off those dates. PTC is platform read-only (cannot be set by DML), so the fresh Force-reprice re-deriving 0.9616...=351/365 PROVES the proc actively computes it, not a stale residual. Co-terming ALL lines together to one shared end-date is evidenced on real Order 801WC00000hJfDUYA0 (8 lines, identical anchor end 2026-09-01, identical PTC). EXPECTATION refinement (not a defect): the catalog's PTC=5/12 is a month-fraction approximation; the org's real math is day-precise (window_days/365), numerically ~equal (5/12=0.4167 vs ~152/365=0.416). No headless base-seed gap: the control is a real pre-existing UI-priced line that was net-positive (250) before and after reprice; the reprice only re-confirmed the already-correct fractional PTC. defect_provenance=none/completeness-gap: the completeness gap (no scenario validated anchor-end proration) is now CLOSED with a PASS - the math is correct and lines co-term to the shared anchor. Read-only + Force-reprice only; no deploys, no proc/flow/metadata edits.
verdict_reason: On real existing TermDefined co-term lines a fresh V21 Force-reprice deterministically re-derives PricingTermCount as the fraction of the line window to its anchor end-date (control 0.9616438356164384 = 351/365 exactly; order 801WC00000hJfDUYA0 co-terms 8 lines to one shared anchor end 2026-09-01 all at 304/365), so the anchor-end proration math and shared-end co-terming behave exactly as expected (the catalog '~5/12' being a month-approximation of the day-precise fraction).
